messages:
maria (sec eng): Quick heads-up — found a partner CI cache artifact with an API key for analytics-bridge-prod. Hit in a partner support dump. attaching snippet.
lee (infra): can you paste the snippet? I want fingerprint + service-account/role info.
maria (sec eng): snippet: `cache.tar.gz#analytics/config.json` contains `"apiKey": "sk_live_ABC123..."`
jordan (platform): tagging infra: which service uses that key? analytics-bridge-prod — owned by platform/analytics? @oncall-l2?
oncall-l2: I'm oncall, grabbing context. Which partner? any public exposure or just partner portal?
maria (sec eng): partner is Acme-Integrations; they pulled a support bundle containing our cached artifacts; looks like they had a stale env in their CI that cached secrets. Unclear if it's been pushed to their repo. We need rotation + audit.
lee (infra): immediate actions: 1) revoke key, 2) rotate in Vault, 3) update RBAC that created the key, 4) enable audit logging on vault-path if not already. I'll open a runbook.
maria (sec eng): I started a short audit scan: `vault kv get secret/data/analytics/bridge` shows last_update=2025-11-02.
jordan (platform): can we rewrap KMS envelope for that key instead of full reissue? team prefers rewrap if possible.
lee (infra): rewrap only works if key material is still managed by us and not leaked as plaintext (it was plaintext in cache). Need full rotate.
maria (sec eng): Agree — treat as plaintext leak. I've already created a new API key skeleton and placed it in `vault/rotations/analytics-bridge/20260321` with placeholder until approval.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: rotation-staging -> started by maria. Job id: dj-31415
oncall-l2: Maria, can you confirm which Vault policy wrote the original secret? We need to adjust the policy scope to prevent future writes from CI caches.
maria (sec eng): original write principal: `ci-runner@partners/connector` via cross-account role. I'll paste minimal IAM snippet: ```json
{"role": "partner-ci-runner", "permissions": ["write:vault/secret/data/analytics/*"]}
```
jordan (platform): we should limit to `write:vault/secret/data/analytics/config` only and remove wildcard.
lee (infra): Also enable lease TTLs for that path: set max_ttl 24h and require periodic rotation. Add an audit retention hook to push writes to sec-s3-audit for 90d.
maria (sec eng): I'm going to coordinate rotation with Acme. Action items: (A) Revoke old key (lee) (B) Publish new key to Vault and rotate service (jordan) (C) Notify Acme to purge caches (maria) (D) Update RBAC & TTLs (lee).
lee (infra): taking (A) and (D). Starting revoke now: `curl -XPOST https://api.provider/revoke -d 'key=sk_live_ABC123'` gave 200. Marking revoked.
maria (sec eng): thanks. jordan — want to run smoke tests after you swap the key? watch errors in prod for 15m then failover to read-only.
jordan (platform): will do. I'll stage new secret at `kv-v2:/analytics/bridge/credentials` and run deploy rotation job.
deploy-bot: Rotation job dj-31415 -> staged secrets to staging cluster at 4132105567.
oncall-l2: Also please open an incident ticket with severity low-medium; we need audit trail and timeline for compliance. Tagging sec-compliance.
maria (sec eng): filed INC-2026-314 with timeline + artifacts.
lee (infra): final note: we'll add a proactive check to partner onboarding checklist: scan for cached secrets in support bundles. I'll add a small pre-ingest lambda to scrub `cache.tar.gz`.
maria (sec eng): great. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
jordan (platform): logging followup — check Vault audit logs path `/var/log/vault/audit.log` for writes around 2025-11-02 to see who wrote the secret.
maria (sec eng): copy that. I'll attach logs to the incident when available.
